scope: Tiny paired local contracts;root-owned runtime qualification is separate.

cases.title: Establish logical content independently of layout
cases.input_contract: Return the ordered list of(id, key, value) tuples for the declared 24-row fixture. Compare its full bag with the literal arithmetic rule and compute count, distinct IDs, sum(id), sum(value).
cases.expected: IDs 0..23 appear once, key=id%4, value=10*id. Metrics are 24,24,276,2760.
cases.verification: Assert every canonical tuple and all four aggregate values.

cases.title: Request keyed redistribution and test colocation
cases.input_contract: Return facts repartitioned to 6 partitions by key. Record its partition count and check that each logical key is observed in exactly one execution partition.
cases.expected: Six partitions requested;all 24 rows unchanged. Each of four keys has one observed partition ID;different keys may share one.
cases.verification: Assert partition metadata 6, canonical equality and per-key countDistinct(partition_id)=1.

cases.title: Reduce partitions without assuming balanced redistribution
cases.input_contract: Coalesce a six-partition input to 2 and return it. Separately request coalesce 10 on the original four-partition relation. Preserve canonical content in both cases.
cases.expected: The first has 2 partitions;the attempted increase remains 4. Both retain the 24-row bag and sum 2760.
cases.verification: Assert both partition counts and complete canonical equality.

cases.title: Reconcile an occupied-partition ledger
cases.input_contract: Return partition_id, row_count, id_total for occupied partitions of the supplied relation. Record total partition metadata separately and do not manufacture empty-partition rows.
cases.expected: Ledger row_count sums 24 and id_total sums 276;each recorded partition ID lies in[0, total_partitions). Occupied count may be lower than total.
cases.verification: Assert reconciliation and partition-ID bounds for both keyed 6 and coalesced 2 layouts.

cases.title: Verify ordering only within its promised scope
cases.input_contract: Return a relation sorted within each partition by key ascending, id ascending. Inspect the sequence of(key, id) pairs within each recorded partition and preserve the logical bag.
cases.expected: Every occupied partition sequence is sorted;the complete canonical relation is unchanged. No raw global collect sequence is required.
cases.verification: Assert per-partition sorted sequences and canonical equality without asserting that raw concatenation must be sorted or unsorted.

cases.title: Create a globally ordered bounded preview
cases.input_contract: Order key descending then event identity id ascending and return the first 5 rows. Repeat after several input layouts.
cases.expected: IDs[3,7,11,15,19], allkey 3 and values[30,70,110,150,190]. The final sixthkey 3 row is outside the limit.
cases.verification: Assert all five ordered tuples from original, keyed and coalesced inputs.
